**Fact.** Newton: F = G m₁m₂/r²; g = GM/r²; at Earth's surface g = GM/R² ≈ 9.8 m/s².
**Fact.** Orbital velocity v = √(GM/r); time period T = 2π√(r³/GM); escape velocity v_esc = √(2GM/r) = √2·v_orbital (at same r).
**Fact.** For a uniform sphere, g ∝ r inside and g = 0 at the centre; g decreases as 1/r² outside.
